title: Renew property insurance
summary: Re-market coverage before expiration and keep the lender's requirements met.
outlineSteps: Calendar the policy expiration and start the renewal early
Confirm the flood zone and any flood coverage the lender requires
Read each lease's insurance and waiver of subrogation terms
Update the property and loss information for the broker
Compare quotes on limits, deductibles and exclusions
Bind coverage before the old policy expires
Send certificates to the lender and tenants
Bill tenants their share as the leases provide
